# CanvasDrawHandler

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

The function that draws a [`CanvasElement`](canvas-element.md): it receives the canvas and the size of the area reserved for the element, in points.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

